component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() names = ["Home", "Movies", "Shows", "Music", "Search", "Settings", "Profile", "Help"] for each id in ["side", "side2", "mlist", "list", "pgrid"] root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for each name in names item = root.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = name item.shortDescriptionLine1 = name end for m.top.findNode(id).content = root end for rowRoot = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") row = rowRoot.createChild("ContentNode") for each name in names row.createChild("ContentNode").title = name end for m.top.findNode("rows").content = rowRoot end sub
' Launch parameter bitmap=9 swaps every node to an opaque 9-patch focus bitmap. sub onBitmap() for each id in ["side", "side2", "mlist", "list", "rows", "pgrid"] m.top.findNode(id).focusBitmapUri = m.top.bitmap end for end sub
' Launch parameter ontop=false|true writes drawFocusFeedbackOnTop on every node. sub onOnTop() for each id in ["side", "side2", "mlist", "list", "rows", "pgrid"] m.top.findNode(id).drawFocusFeedbackOnTop = (m.top.onTop = "true") end for end sub
sub onTarget() for each id in ["side", "side2", "mlist", "list", "rows", "pgrid"] node = m.top.findNode(id) print "PROBE|" + id + " drawFocusFeedbackOnTop=" + node.drawFocusFeedbackOnTop.toStr() + " drawFocusFeedback=" + node.drawFocusFeedback.toStr() end for m.top.findNode(m.top.target).setFocus(true) end sub
